title.full: Ways to find your property’s Annual Value

summary.text: You can check IRAS e-Valuation List, your property tax bill, or myTax.iras.gov.sg.

details.heading: IRAS e-Valuation List
details.body: You can find your residence’s Annual Value from IRAS e-Valuation List at a nominal fee.

details.heading: Other ways to check
details.body: You may also check your property tax bill or log in to myTax.iras.gov.sg.

details.heading: Typical HDB Annual Value
details.body: The Annual Value of HDB properties generally falls below $21,000.

steps.name: Choose a way
steps.text: Find your Annual Value using IRAS e-Valuation List, your property tax bill, or myTax.iras.gov.sg.
